sources.title: Afghanistan travel recommendations
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation of Spain
sources.officialityEvidence: Spain's live MAEC destination guidance, last updated 24 April 2026, directly addresses entry documents for Spanish travellers to Afghanistan.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Para entrar en Afganistán se requiere visado. No es posible obtener visado en frontera.

sources.title: Iran travel recommendations
sources.publisher: Embassy of Spain in Tehran, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: Spain's live Embassy in Tehran MAEC guidance, last updated 13 April 2026, directly addresses Spanish citizens' tourist-visa treatment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Irán dejó de expedir visados en frontera (visa on arrival) desde el inicio de la pandemia.

sources.title: North Korea travel recommendations
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation of Spain
sources.jurisdiction: Spain / Democratic People's Republic of Korea
sources.officialityEvidence: Spain's live MAEC destination guidance, last updated 6 May 2026, directly states the visitor-visa and current-route conditions for Spanish travellers to DPRK.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Se necesita visado, ya sea por turismo o negocios.

conflicts.explanation: Current MAEC guidance says Iran has not officially resumed border visas and requires a pre-application, but does not establish the resulting ordinary tourist visa's issuance point.

unresolved.reason: Current MAEC guidance requires a visa and excludes border issuance, but de facto requirements may vary or be non-public and no usable ordinary Spanish tourist issuance channel is established.
MAEC requires a tourism or business visa and identifies China and Russia as current access routes, but does not establish ordinary Spanish visitor issuance timing or operational availability.

MAEC says Iran has not officially resumed border visas and requires a pre-application before travel, but does not establish whether the resulting ordinary Spanish tourist visa is electronic or mission-issued.
